scripts.check: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build
scripts.desktop:prepare: pnpm desktop:runtime:build && pnpm desktop:web:build && pnpm cs2d:build && pnpm --dir apps/desktop prepare:runtime
scripts.desktop:test:unit: pnpm --filter @cs-coach/desktop-runtime test && pnpm --dir apps/desktop prepare:runtime:test && pnpm --dir apps/desktop smoke:sidecar && cargo test --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.desktop:test: pnpm desktop:prepare && pnpm desktop:test:unit && pnpm --dir apps/desktop smoke:runtime-real
scripts.desktop:dev: pnpm desktop:prepare && pnpm --dir apps/desktop tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm desktop:prepare && pnpm --dir apps/desktop tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles app && pnpm --dir apps/desktop create:dmg
scripts.release:check: node --test tools/desktop-release/audit.test.mjs && node tools/desktop-release/audit.mjs workflow --path .github/workflows/desktop-release.yml && pnpm distribution:audit
scripts.cloudflare:build: NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOY_TARGET=cloudflare pnpm cs2d:build && NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOY_TARGET=cloudflare node tools/assert-cloudflare-env-clean.mjs && (cd apps/web && NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOY_TARGET=cloudflare ../../node_modules/.bin/opennextjs-cloudflare build -c ../../wrangler.jsonc --openNextConfigPath ../../open-next.config.ts) && NEXT_PUBLIC_DEPLOY_TARGET=cloudflare node tools/assert-cloudflare-env-clean.mjs --bundle
scripts.cloudflare:deploy: pnpm cloudflare:build && pnpm cloudflare:assets && pnpm exec wrangler deploy tools/cloudflare-worker.mjs --config wrangler.jsonc --assets apps/web/.open-next/cloudflare-assets
